status: focused CPU accounting correctness qualification passed; full storage migration is separate
owner_cpu: Cumulative shared per-caller supplement includes completed and currently active owner-job CPU; scopes never reset it. All overlapping watchdogs and elapsed billing use the same counter. Queue waits are excluded. Exceptions and completion exchange debt once under its mutex.
cancellation: Nested request contexts retain all parent cancellation. Native atomic publication is explicitly accepted before irreversible effects; cancellation cannot abandon its synchronous root/socket/callback completion. No new publications are accepted after timeout.
linux_clock: pthread target CPU clock; no signal or timer policy change

darwin_clock.reservation: Explicitly checks existing disposition; rejects preexisting or subsequently replaced handler/flags. Process lifetime installation is retained after watchdog destruction for queued late deliveries. Accounted threads preinitialize TLS before requests. Blocked signal at initial capture is rejected. Host integrations must keep the reserved signal available outside bounded accepted publication I/O.
darwin_clock.handler: Only lock-free atomic operations, async-signal-safe clock_gettime(CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID), preinitialized TLS, and errno save/restore; SA_RESTART and SA_ONSTACK. No locks, allocation, callbacks, or C++ ownership changes in the handler.
darwin_clock.lifetime: Per-thread state owns one Mach send right. A normal-thread send/exit mutex prevents pthread handle reuse during send. ESRCH before TLS teardown is treated as exiting. Persistent state supports final real CPU readings after owner exit; right released by last state owner.
darwin_clock.sample_wait: At most a 1ms logical wait with short sleeps; on delayed delivery reads real Mach thread CPU. All samples retain the largest actually observed CPU. No wall-time extrapolation. Scheduler delays can exceed the logical wait.
darwin_clock.timer: Darwin kqueue NOTE_CRITICAL timer plus EVFILT_USER wake avoids ordinary condition-variable timer coalescing; original test budgets unchanged.
darwin_clock.accepted_io: SIGUSR2 is masked only across accepted native root commit/fsync because maintained SAL does not retry EINTR; restored immediately afterward. Its real CPU remains available through the Mach fallback.
